title: intents.close
description: Mark recorded gap(s) closed — a capability the gap noted now exists. Appends a closure event (the JSONL log stays append-only; nothing is rewritten) and returns { ok: true, count, closed: [{ id, text }] }. Provide ONE selector: { id: string } closes that gap by id, or { match: string } closes every OPEN gap whose text contains the (case-insensitive) substring. If both are given, id wins. A request matching no open gap is a no-op (count 0). At least one selector is required.
